question: Do exact first-party Fujifilm E-6 source profiles provide a stable joint stock signature across Velvia 50, Velvia 100 and Provia 100F using composite-MTF shape plus like-for-like 48-micrometre diffuse RMS granularity?

comparison.interpolation: linear in log10 spatial frequency and natural-log response
comparison.mtf_metric: root mean square difference of normalized natural-log response
comparison.joint_pair_rule: a stock pair is materially distinct when MTF RMSE is at least its MTF gate or absolute diffuse RMS granularity difference is at least its granularity gate

stop_rules: Do not tune trace points, frequencies, normalization, pair rule, uncertainty model or gates after any cross-stock score.
Do not use the invalid U5.R2BW0 Velvia 50 MTF curve or repair its failed axis calibration; reuse only its exact like-for-like scalar granularity observation.
Failure closes this exact manufacturer-source joint signature without curve-capacity, stock-subset or threshold rescue.

Pass may retain a non-renderable stock source profile and open a separately frozen independent-observation leaf only; it cannot open a PSF, NPS, RGB transform, stock calibration, photographic render or product profile.
claim_ceiling: First-party same-manufacturer E-6 technical-source distinction under explicit graph digitization uncertainty; not independent rolls, process/scanner calibration, spectral colour response, NPS, microscopic structure, photographic appearance, stock-response calibration or product evidence.
